# From twkbC, by the author of the format

- **Source:** <https://github.com/nicklasaven/twkbC>, commit `a026d7c8643f695bc584a2a5390dcf5905687c2f` (2015-11-21).
- **License:** MIT (`LICENSE`, copied from the repository). Its `testdata/kommuner.twkb` is left out: the repository gives no license for the data.

| File | What it holds |
|---|---|
| `mod.rs` | The TWKB of [`minunit_test.c`](https://github.com/nicklasaven/twkbC/blob/a026d7c8643f695bc584a2a5390dcf5905687c2f/tests/minunit_test.c) with the geometries it expects, from GeoJSON to WKT: polygons with holes, collections with IDs, a stream of two points, a line string with 5 digits |
